title: Verizon offers iPhone 18 Pro with annual upgrades | About Verizon
summary: Verizon is offering the new foldable iPhone Duo alongside the iPhone 18 Pro lineup with pre-orders beginning October 16, 2026, and wide availability starting October 23
body_markdown:
# Switch to Verizon and get the new iPhone Duo now. No trade-in needed.


With no upgrade fees, no activation fees and cash back in Verizon Dollars just for being a customer, plus get three months of Apple One on us. The choice is simple.


[Español](https://www.verizon.com/about/news/es/verizon-ofertas-preventa-iphone-18-pro)


Published Oct 16, 2026


G


Media contact:George Koroneos


Published Oct 16, 2026


## At a glance


-


Get iPhone Duo now and choose Apple Watch Series 12 or iPad on us when you switch to Verizon, plus get three months of Apple One on us.
-


No activation or upgrade fees when you enroll in Verizon Loyalty.
-


Cash back in Verizon Dollars just for being a customer, plus exclusive daily drops and epic experiences with Verizon Shine.
-


iPhone Handoff coming to Verizon. Share one Verizon number across two compatible iPhone models with iOS 27, including iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo.


**NEW YORK, N.Y.** —It’s official. Verizon will offer[iPhone Duo](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/apple-iphone-duo/) , the first foldable iPhone, with pre-orders beginning Friday, October 16. iPhone Duo hits stores on Friday, October 23, joining[iPhone 18 Pro](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/apple-iphone-18-pro/) and[iPhone 18 Pro Max](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/apple-iphone-18-pro-max/) . With a breakthrough design that opens to a versatile 7.6-inch display for gaming and multitasking and closes to a pocketable 5.4-inch screen, there’s never been a better time to upgrade than with iPhone Duo. Built to last with a durable precision hinge, it pairs an advanced camera system with impressive all-day battery life.


For customers who are tired of complexity and want a simple, cost-effective plan alongside the new iPhone lineup, Verizon offers simple pricing, no activation or upgrade fees and a brand-new iPhone every single year. Plus, Verizon is offering the latest Apple products, including[Apple Watch Series 12](https://www.verizon.com/connected-smartwatches/apple-watch-series-12/) ,[Apple Watch Ultra 4](https://www.verizon.com/connected-smartwatches/apple-watch-ultra-4/) and[AirPods 5](https://www.verizon.com/products/apple-airpods-5/) .


Simplicity moves beyond tiered network confusion and provides a simple choice for mobile service, with options to get a new phone every year. With America’s Most Reliable 5G Network*


for everyone at an affordable price, including unlimited 5G Ultra Wideband data, 10GB of premium mobile hotspot and roaming in Canada and Mexico all standard. That’s it. That’s the plan.


## iPhone Handoff coming soon to Verizon


Verizon will support iPhone Handoff, giving customers the flexibility to use a single Verizon phone number seamlessly across two compatible iPhone models. Whether using the pocketable iPhone Duo on the go or iPhone 18 Pro for work, customers can switch active status between devices at any time while keeping full access to Verizon’s 5G network. iPhone Handoff will be available from Verizon for $10/month on compatible iPhones models running iOS 27.


## Get a new iPhone now


-


**Get iPhone Duo now and choose Apple Watch Series 12 or iPad on us** when you switch to Verizon. Enjoy zero activation or upgrade fees when enrolled in Verizon Loyalty, plus get three months of Apple One on us ($17/month afterwards).


-


**How it works:** Purchase iPhone Duo (256 GB) on an eligible Verizon plan. Select Apple Watch or iPad and add a new qualifying service line (min. $20/mo w/Auto Pay (+taxes/fees) on a 36-month payment plan, 0% APR, to receive up to $600 in monthly credits. Additional terms apply.


-


**Get iPhone Duo for $72 a month** when you switch to Verizon and sign up for Simplicity. Plus get no upgrade or activation fees when you enroll in Verizon Loyalty.


-


**How it works:** Purchase iPhone Duo (256 GB) on a 48-month device payment plan with a new line on the Simplicity Plan with Auto Pay and pay just $72 a month ($42/mo for the iPhone and $30/mo for the plan, plus taxes and fees), 0% APR. Additional terms apply.


-


**Get iPhone 18 Pro now with annual upgrades, and get Apple Watch or iPad on us:** Get iPhone 18 Pro now with no trade-in required when you sign up for the Simplicity Plan with Simplicity Pro, plus your choice of Apple Watch Series 12 or iPad on us. Enjoy zero activation or upgrade fees when enrolled in Verizon Loyalty, three months of Apple One on us ($17/month afterwards) and the ability to get the latest iPhone every year.


-


**Here’s how it works:** Purchase an iPhone 18 Pro (256 GB) on a 36-month device payment plan with a new or upgraded line on the Simplicity Plan with Simplicity Pro to receive $1,200 in bill credits over 36 months, 0% APR. Select Apple Watch Series 12 or iPad and add a new qualifying service line (min. $20/mo w/Auto Pay (+taxes/fees) with Auto Pay on a 36-month payment plan to receive up to $600 in monthly promo credits, 0% APR. To upgrade every year, return your iPhone in good working condition once 33% of the device agreement is paid. Additional terms apply.


-


**Trade in and save up to $1,200 with myPlan:** Trade in an eligible phone and add a new line to receive up to $1,000 off a new iPhone on select plans.


-


**How it works:** Purchase a new iPhone on a 36-month, interest-free payment plan and trade in an eligible Apple, Google, Motorola or Samsung phone. Verizon covers up to $1,200 via monthly promo credits applied over 36 months, 0% APR. Additional terms apply.


-


**Switch and save up to $1,200 with myPlan:** Switch to Verizon and save up to $1,200 off a new iPhone on select plans.


-


**How it works:** Switch to Verizon and purchase a new iPhone on a 36-month, interest-free payment plan. Verizon covers up to $1,200 via monthly promo credits applied over 36 months, 0% APR. Additional terms apply.


-


**Verizon Business iPhone Duo offers:** Get up to $1,200 off the new iPhone Duo with eligible trade-in.


-


**How it works:** For a limited time, new and existing Business Markets and Enterprise customers can pre-order and get up to $1,200 off a new iPhone Duo with eligible trade-in, new line, device payment plan and My Biz Plan with $20 monthly add-on spend. All credits applied over 36 months.


-


**Verizon Business iPhone 18 Pro offer:** Get iPhone 18 Pro (256GB) on us, or save up to $1,200 on iPhone 18 Pro Max with eligible trade-in.


-


**How it works:** For a limited time, new and existing Business Markets and Enterprise customers can switch to receive up to $1,200 off a new iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max with an eligible trade-in, device payment plan and My Biz Plan with $20 monthly add-on spend. Plus, customers can save $360 when they port in their existing number. All credits applied over 36 months.


## Verizon Loyalty: The only loyalty program for ALL customers on any plan


**Goodbye activation and upgrade fees:** All postpaid customers on all phone and connected device plans can opt-in to Verizon’s Loyalty program and say goodbye to activation and upgrade fees—that’s up to $40 in fees per device.


**Verizon Dollars:** A first-of-its-kind program that rewards customers with 3% back in Verizon Dollars every single month, just for being a customer. Verizon Dollars can be redeemed for devices (including the latest iPhones models), accessories or up to 5x for each Verizon Dollar from top brands.


**Verizon Shine, every Monday, every day, all year-round:** The loyalty program that gives customers a reason to look forward to Monday, all year-round. All Verizon customers on any plan can enter weekly for a chance to win once-in-a-lifetime experiences, alongside daily drops including tickets to concerts and sporting events, exclusive merchandise, dining vouchers, gift cards and more. Opt-in into loyalty in one simple step through the My Verizon app.


## The latest iPhone models


[iPhone Duo](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/apple-iphone-duo/) is the first foldable iPhone, featuring a breakthrough design that’s beautiful, versatile and durable. iPhone Duo opens to a large 7.6-inch inner display for viewing content, gaming, and multitasking, and closes to a compact, pocketable 5.4-inch outer display. Built to last with an innovative hardware design and precision hinge, iPhone Duo is powered by A20 Pro to deliver pro performance and impressive all-day battery life, and offers an advanced camera system, with the folding design unlocking fun new ways to use the camera that aren’t possible on any other iPhone. iOS 27 is also reimagined for the versatile ways users can interact with iPhone Duo.


[iPhone 18 Pro](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/apple-iphone-18-pro/) and[iPhone 18 Pro Max](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/apple-iphone-18-pro-max/) offer the new 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture, the most advanced camera Apple has ever made, and new Pro controls let users customize their experience. Powered by A20 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max deliver huge leaps in battery life and performance. iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro models feature Apple Intelligence¹


and Siri AI²


, an entirely new version of Siri, rolling out in beta in English with iOS 27, to bring AI capabilities together with a user’s personal context to become an intelligent personal hub with privacy and security at the core. iPhone Duo is available in two refined colors: star white and night sky. iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are available in four elegant finishes: black, silver, glacier and an all-new burgundy.


iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro models feature eSIM³


, offering greater flexibility, better security, seamless connectivity compared to traditional physical SIM cards, and more battery life on eSIM-only models. iPhone Duo features an eSIM-only design that saves internal space to maximize battery capacity while eSIM-only models of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max take advantage of the space formerly occupied by the physical SIM with a larger battery that provides two additional hours of video playback.


## The newest Apple Watch models


[Apple Watch Series 12](https://www.verizon.com/connected-smartwatches/apple-watch-series-12/) and[Apple Watch Ultra 4](https://www.verizon.com/connected-smartwatches/apple-watch-ultra-4/) offer the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable⁴


. Both new models have been engineered with the new Health Sensing System and S11 chip to offer an enhanced suite of health and fitness features including a new readiness score, higher-frequency heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) measurements, plus extended workout battery life and faster charging. Apple Watch Series 12 is available in 42mm and 46mm sizes in an array of beautiful finishes, including dark bronze, black, light gold and space gray aluminum; radiant gold and natural titanium; and a stunning ceramic material, in pearl white and night blue. Apple Watch Ultra 4 is available in natural and black titanium.


With watchOS 27, Apple Intelligence comes to the wrist, bringing Siri AI to Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 with personal context understanding and broad world knowledge⁵


. Arriving later this year, new Audio Intelligence features roll out in beta in English to help users stay aware of the world around them, catch what they missed, and remember key moments—with user control, privacy, security, and accessibility at the center of their design⁶


—along with a redesigned Health app on iPhone and iPad, starting in U.S. English, including a new Longevity tab with a Health Age feature showing how metrics are tracking relative to a user’s age⁷


.


## Introducing AirPods 5


[AirPods 5](https://www.verizon.com/products/apple-airpods-5/) deliver the industry’s best Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)⁸


in an open-ear design, powered by a new multiport acoustic architecture and next-generation Adaptive EQ for even more immersive sound. Their breakthrough open-ear ANC removes up to 50 percent more external noise compared to the previous generation, alongside a more natural Transparency mode. Combined with Siri AI and iPhone, AirPods enable users to draw on their personal context and get answers with broad world knowledge, entirely hands-free¹


. Users can also respond to Siri using head gestures or use Live Translation to help connect across languages. For users who want even more,[AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case](https://www.verizon.com/products/apple-airpods-5-with-wireless-charging-case/) adds longer battery life and on-stem volume control⁹


.


## Get your new iPhone at Verizon


Visit[Verizon.com](http://verizon.com/) , the My Verizon app or your local Verizon store to order your[iPhone 18 Pro](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/apple-iphone-18-pro/) ,[iPhone 18 Pro Max](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/apple-iphone-18-pro-max/) ,[Apple Watch Series 12](https://www.verizon.com/connected-smartwatches/apple-watch-series-12/) ,[Apple Watch Ultra 4](https://www.verizon.com/connected-smartwatches/apple-watch-ultra-4/) , and[AirPods 5](https://www.verizon.com/products/apple-airpods-5/) .[iPhone Duo](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/apple-iphone-duo/) will be available to pre-order starting on Friday, October 16 with wide availability on October 23. Verizon Business customers can visit the[Verizon Business website](https://www.verizon.com/business/) or contact their account manager to order. All new iPhone models will also be available from Visible, StraightTalk, Total Wireless and Verizon Prepaid.
